Klasse Attempt<A>

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Attempt<A>
Typparameter:
A - the type of the contained value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Appliable<Attempt.µ, A>, Bindable<Attempt.µ, A>, Mappable<Attempt.µ, A>, Monadic<Attempt.µ, A>, Triable<A>, UnsafeMonadic<Attempt.µ, A>, Unwindable<Attempt<A>>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Attempt.µ, A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Attempt.µ>
public final class Attempt<A> extends Object implements Monadic<Attempt.µ, A>, UnsafeMonadic<Attempt.µ, A>, Unwindable<Attempt<A>>, Triable<A>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Attempt.µ, A>

A lazy error monad for computations that may succeed with a value or fail with an exception.

An Attempt<A> defers evaluation by storing a supplier of Result<A>. On evaluation, it produces either a Result.Success<A> or a Result.Failure<A>. The API provides transformations, error handling, and safe processing while preserving laziness where possible.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null. Transformations should not return null. Exceptions thrown by user-provided functions are captured and represented as failures.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • tryIt

      @UnwindingOperation public @NonNull Result<A> tryIt()

      Evaluates the deferred computation and returns its Result.

      This method “unwinds” the lazy computation and is safe to call multiple times; it does not throw, but returns failures as Result.Failure.

      Angegeben von:

      Gibt zurück:

    • onFailureRecover

      public Attempt<A> onFailureRecover(@NonNull Supplier<A> recover)

      Specifies a lazy recovery path if evaluation fails, using the given supplier.

      Recovery is attempted only when the computation is evaluated and only in the failure case. If the supplier throws or yields null, the resulting failure will contain that exception (with the original exception added as suppressed in case of NullPointerException).

      Parameter:
      recover - supplies the recovery value; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      an Attempt that yields either the original success or the recovery value
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if recover is null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • onFailureRecover

      public Attempt<A> onFailureRecover(@NonNull Function<? super Exception, ? extends A> recover)

      Specifies a lazy recovery function if evaluation fails.

      The function receives the stored exception and returns a recovery value. If it throws or returns null, the resulting failure contains the thrown exception.

      Parameter:
      recover - maps the exception to a recovery value; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      an Attempt yielding either the original success or the recovered value
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if recover is null or returns null
      Seit:
      1.0.0

      @UnwindingOperation public Attempt<A> onFailureThrow() throws Exception

      Unwinds this computation, throwing the stored exception on failure.

      If successful, returns this unchanged. Otherwise, throws the stored exception.

    • peekFailureLazy

      public Attempt<A> peekFailureLazy(@NonNull Consumer<? super Exception> failureConsumer)

      Registers a lazy side effect to be executed if evaluation fails.

      The consumer is invoked during evaluation and only for failures. The returned Attempt preserves laziness and does not modify the underlying result.

      Parameter:
      failureConsumer - consumes the failure exception; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      an Attempt that will run the side effect on failure during evaluation
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if failureConsumer is null
